title: Ko T T1c — Photo upload + realistic variation gallery with manifesto intro (frontend)

requirements.summary: Add a landing/intro screen that renders the full Ko T T1C manifesto and tagline exactly as provided (including the Louis Vuitton URL).
acceptanceCriteria: The landing/intro screen shows the title “Ko T T1C — The Chaos That Finally Makes Sense”.
The full manifesto text is present (not truncated) and readable on mobile and desktop.
The tagline text appears exactly as provided.
The Louis Vuitton URL (https://www.louisvuitton.com) appears correctly in the rendered text.

file_operations.description: Create the app shell with navigation and a Landing/Intro view that renders the full manifesto + tagline as exact, copy-pasted English text (including https://www.louisvuitton.com), using responsive layout and readable typography. Use shadcn-ui building blocks (e.g., button/card/dialog where applicable) to keep UI consistent; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Implement the Landing/Intro view UI with the exact title, full manifesto text (non-truncated), and tagline; ensure long-form text wraps and remains readable on mobile/desktop. Use shadcn-ui components for structured layout (e.g., Card) as needed; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a simple top navigation used by App to reach Landing, Upload/Generate, and History views without adding extra routes beyond what the request needs. Use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Button) for nav actions; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Implement single-photo (JPG/PNG) upload with client-side validation, preview, and replace/remove controls before generation.
acceptanceCriteria: User can select a JPG/PNG file from their device.
The selected image renders as a preview with filename and basic info (e.g., dimensions/size if available).
The UI validates file type and enforces a clear max file size limit with a user-friendly error message when exceeded.
User can remove/replace the selected photo before generating.

file_operations.description: Create the upload UI for a single JPG/PNG, including max file size validation with user-friendly errors, preview rendering, and remove/replace actions before generation. Use shadcn-ui inputs/buttons/cards and (optional) toast messaging for errors; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a reusable image picker component that validates type/size, extracts basic metadata (filename, size, and dimensions when available), and emits a preview URL. Use shadcn-ui input/label components for consistent styling; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add utilities to read image dimensions and format metadata safely in-browser (no external services), supporting JPG/PNG and returning size/dimensions where available.

requirements.summary: Generate a configurable set of realistic, identity-preserving variations on-device (no external AI), display them in a gallery with larger view and download.
acceptanceCriteria: The app can produce a configurable number of variations (minimum 4) from one uploaded image.
Variations keep the original photo’s subject unchanged (no face/body warping; no added limbs).
Variations change background and/or photographic styling (e.g., color grade, lighting, depth-of-field effects) while keeping output realistic and non-cartoonish.
Each generated variation is displayed as an image the user can open in a larger view and download.

file_operations.description: Define a set of realistic, photography-style presets (e.g., color grade, exposure/contrast curves, subtle film grain, vignette, depth-of-field simulation) that do not warp geometry. Include preset identifiers to support non-duplicate regeneration logic.

Implement an on-device image processing pipeline using Canvas/Web APIs to render preset-based variations as images (data URLs/blobs). Prefer non-warping operations; optionally use on-device FaceDetector (if available) to keep face region sharp while applying background blur/grade, with safe fallback to whole-image stylization when unavailable.

Create a responsive grid that displays generated variations with actions (open, download, mark bad) and status indicators. Use shadcn-ui Card/Button/DropdownMenu (if present) for consistent actions; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add a larger-view modal/dialog for a variation image with download action. Use shadcn-ui Dialog for accessibility and consistent UI; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire generation controls: choose number of variations (min 4), run on-device processing, render results via VariationGrid, and allow opening a larger view and downloading each variation. Use shadcn-ui controls for number selection and actions; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add a quality-guard UX to hide/flag distorted outputs and regenerate replacements using a different preset.
acceptanceCriteria: Each variation card includes an action to mark it as bad/hidden.
Hidden variations are not shown in the default grid but can be viewed/restored from a “Hidden” section.
User can regenerate a replacement variation for a hidden/bad item.
Regeneration produces a different preset result than the hidden item (not a duplicate).

file_operations.description: Add state helpers for tracking variation items, their preset IDs, hidden/visible status, and replacement/regeneration while ensuring regenerated items use a different preset than the flagged one.

Add per-card actions to mark a variation as bad/hidden and trigger regeneration. Ensure hidden items are removed from the default grid view and actions are clearly labeled. Use shadcn-ui Button/DropdownMenu for actions where appropriate; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a 'Hidden' section UI to list hidden variations with restore and regenerate actions. Use shadcn-ui Tabs/Accordion/Card (as available) for a clean UX; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire the HiddenVariationsPanel into the generation screen, connect hide/restore/regenerate actions, and ensure regeneration picks a different preset to avoid duplicates.

requirements.summary: Persist a lightweight local history of submissions (original + variations + timestamps) and provide a History view to revisit prior sessions.
acceptanceCriteria: A “History” view lists prior submissions with a thumbnail and created time.
Selecting a history item shows the original image and its variations.
History persists across page refreshes (at minimum via frontend local persistence; backend persistence may be added if size limits allow).

file_operations.description: Implement lightweight frontend persistence (e.g., localStorage/IndexedDB) for submissions: original image reference (data URL or stored blob key), variation image references, and timestamps, with safe size-aware limits and basic migration/versioning.

Create a History view that lists past submissions with thumbnail + created time and allows selecting an item to view original + variations. Use shadcn-ui Card/Button/Separator for list layout; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create the detail panel for a selected history item showing the original image and variation gallery, reusing VariationGrid and the larger-view dialog. Use shadcn-ui components for layout consistency; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
After successful generation, append the submission (original + variations + timestamp) into local history storage so it persists across refreshes.

Wire the new History view into app navigation and ensure selecting history items is supported without introducing unrelated pages. Use shadcn-ui navigation elements where applicable; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Apply a coherent neon/chaos-couture visual theme consistently across landing, upload/generation, and history views with accessible contrast.
acceptanceCriteria: Theme is consistently applied (colors, typography, spacing, buttons, cards).
Theme aligns with the brand vibe suggested by the provided Ko T T1c imagery (neon/chaos couture feel) without defaulting to a generic look.
All text remains readable with accessible contrast on both desktop and mobile.

file_operations.description: Create global styles and Tailwind base layers for a neon/chaos-couture theme: dark background, neon accents, readable typography for long-form manifesto text, and accessible contrast defaults across components.
Extend Tailwind theme tokens (colors/radii/shadows/animations) to support neon accent palette and consistent styling across views.

Create a shared layout wrapper to enforce consistent spacing, background treatment, and typography across Landing, Upload/Generate, and History. Use shadcn-ui layout-friendly primitives (Card/Separator) as needed; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wrap all views in AppLayout and ensure theme consistency across navigation, surfaces, and text styles. Use shadcn-ui components consistently; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Include the provided Ko T T1c images as static branding elements and add required generated branding assets (icon/hero bg/favicon) served from frontend static assets.
acceptanceCriteria: The two uploaded images are included in the frontend as static assets and used in the UI (at least one visible on the landing screen).
Images are served from the frontend static assets path (not fetched through the backend canister).
Layout remains responsive and does not cause overflow or unreadable text.

file_operations.description: Add the user-provided Ko T T1c branding image as a static frontend asset for use in the UI.
Add the user-provided Ko T T1c branding image as a static frontend asset for use in the UI.
Add the required generated image asset: Neon couture-style app icon on dark background (ko-tt1c-app-icon.dim_512x512.png).
Add the required generated image asset: Neon couture-style wide hero background with abstract light leaks and subtle flame motifs (ko-tt1c-hero-bg.dim_1600x900.png).
Add the required generated image asset: Minimal neon mark/favicon variant on dark background (ko-tt1c-favicon.dim_64x64.png).
Wire the generated favicon asset (frontend/public/assets/generated/ko-tt1c-favicon.dim_64x64.png) into the document head so it is served as a static asset.

Place at least one of the static branding images (frontend/public/assets/branding/1770656359337.png and/or frontend/public/assets/branding/1770656359337-1.png) visibly on the landing screen and use the generated hero background (frontend/public/assets/generated/ko-tt1c-hero-bg.dim_1600x900.png) as a brand element while keeping layout responsive.

Add a small brand mark usage (e.g., icon/wordmark display) using static assets so branding is present across views without backend image routing. Use shadcn-ui components for consistent nav styling; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
